TMC MP Seeks UN Intervention on Kolkata Water Crisis

Trinamool Congress (TMC) Member of Parliament Samirul Islam has written to the United Nations (UN) High Commissioner for Human Rights regarding the drinking water crisis in a Kolkata colony. The letter seeks UN intervention to address the issue.
